description: sign up for a new gym membership
utterances: how do i become a member here, what are the options
I've just moved to the area and I'm looking to start training regularly, could you walk me through the different plans and what joining involves?

description: temporarily pause my membership
utterances: can i put my plan on hold for two months
I'm having knee surgery next month and won't be able to train for a while, is there a way to stop paying for a few months without losing my rate?

description: reactivate a paused membership early
utterances: i'm healed up, can you switch my plan back on
My hold was supposed to run until the end of next month but I'm ready to get back in, please restart it from this week.

description: end my membership completely
utterances: i want out, how do i quit the gym
I'm relocating abroad for work at the end of the month and won't be coming back, what do I need to do to close my plan here for good?

description: upgrade to a plan with more access
utterances: want to move up to the tier with the pool
I'm on the basic off-peak plan right now but my shifts have changed and I'd like to be able to come in evenings and use the sauna too.

description: switch to a cheaper plan
utterances: can i drop down to the off peak option
I hardly ever use the classes or the pool anymore so paying for the full package doesn't make sense, what's the most basic level you have?

description: move my membership to a different branch
utterances: i moved house, can i switch to the downtown club
My new office is right next to your other location across town, so I'd like that one to become my main gym instead of this one.

description: ask why my monthly fee went up
utterances: why am i paying more this month than last
I noticed the amount taken for my membership this month is higher than what I signed up for, nobody told me about a price change, can you explain?

description: buy a single day pass
utterances: just visiting, can i pay for one session
I'm in town for a couple of days on business and want to get a workout in, is there a way to use the gym without joining?

description: bring a guest to train with me
utterances: can my friend come along with me tomorrow
My sister is staying with me this weekend and I'd love to have her join my morning session, what are the rules and is there a charge?

description: add a family member to my plan
utterances: can my husband go on my membership too
My teenage son wants to start lifting and I've heard you do a household discount, how do I get him attached to my existing agreement?

description: check whether my membership is still active
utterances: am i still signed up or did it lapse
I haven't been in for almost a year and I'm not sure if I'm still on the books or whether it expired, could you look me up?

description: book a session with a personal trainer
utterances: i'd like some one on one coaching, who's free this week
I've plateaued on my own and think I need someone to push me, could you set me up with an hour with one of your coaches?

description: switch to a different personal trainer
utterances: can i get someone else to coach me instead
The coach I've been working with is fine but our schedules just don't line up anymore, I'd like to move my remaining sessions to someone with evening availability.

description: cancel an upcoming personal training session
utterances: gotta skip my thursday session with the coach
I've picked up a cold and don't want to pass it on, please take me out of tomorrow's one on one and tell me if I'll still be charged.

description: ask how much a block of trainer sessions costs
utterances: what do you charge for ten sessions with a coach
I'm weighing up whether to commit to regular coaching and want to see the price list for bundles versus paying for each hour individually.

description: get an initial fitness assessment
utterances: can someone measure where i'm at before i start
I'm brand new to training and have no idea about my baseline, I'd like a staff member to run me through body composition and strength tests first.

description: get a written training programme from a coach
utterances: could a trainer write me a weekly routine
I want to train four times a week on my own but I keep doing random exercises, can someone put together a structured schedule for me to follow?

description: reserve a place in a group class
utterances: sign me up for spin on tuesday evening
I saw the yoga session listed for Saturday mornings and would like to secure a spot for this week before it fills up.

description: join the waiting list for a full class
utterances: pilates is full, can you put me down if someone drops
The Wednesday evening boxing session shows no spaces left, I'd like to be next in line and notified the moment somebody cancels.

description: cancel my spot in a class
utterances: can't make zumba tonight, take me off the list
I booked the early morning circuit session for tomorrow but something has come up, please release my place so someone else can have it.

description: ask when a particular class runs
utterances: what days do you run the hiit sessions
I'm interested in trying aqua aerobics but can't find the timetable anywhere, could you tell me which mornings it's on and how long it lasts?

description: complain a class was cancelled without warning
utterances: showed up for yoga and nobody was there, no message either
I rearranged my whole evening to attend the strength session and only found out at the front desk that it wasn't happening, that's really not good enough.

description: suggest adding a new type of class
utterances: any chance you'd start doing kettlebell sessions
A bunch of us regulars have been talking and we'd really love a dedicated mobility and stretching session on weekday mornings, is that something you'd consider?

description: rent a locker to keep for the season
utterances: can i get my own locker i don't have to empty
I come in every day before work and hauling my kit back and forth is a pain, do you have long term storage I could pay for monthly?

description: get a jammed locker unlocked
utterances: my locker won't budge and my stuff is inside
The combination on the locker I used this morning isn't working anymore and my clothes and keys are all in there, can someone come and open it?

description: report something i left behind at the gym
utterances: think i left my water bottle by the treadmills yesterday
I had a grey hoodie with me during the evening class last night and it never made it home, has anyone handed it in to reception?

description: report a machine that is out of order
utterances: the third rowing machine's screen is dead again
One of the cable crossover stations on the upper floor has a frayed wire and it's honestly a safety hazard, someone should take a look before it snaps.

description: complain about dirty changing rooms or showers
utterances: the men's showers have been filthy all week
There's been hair and mud on the floor of the changing area every morning this week and the bins are overflowing, when was it last properly cleaned?

description: ask the opening times on public holidays
utterances: are you open on christmas day or boxing day
I'm planning to train through the long weekend coming up, will the club be running normal hours or closing early on the holiday itself?

description: replace a lost entry fob
utterances: lost my key tag, can i get another one
The little tag I scan at the turnstile fell off my keyring somewhere and I've been signing in manually all week, how do I get a new one?

description: complain about how a staff member treated me
utterances: one of your trainers was really rude to me today
The person at the front desk this morning made a sarcastic comment about my weight in front of other members and I want it reported to the manager.
